scenes.name: ONE NUMBER
lines: Conway's Frac-tran machine keeps one whole number as its state, and a list of fractions as its program.
康威的 FRACTRAN 机器只有一个正整数作状态，一列分数作程序。
Each beat, multiply by the first fraction that keeps the number whole.
每一拍，用第一枚能让它保持整数的分数去乘它。
When no denominator divides, the machine halts.
没有任何分母整除时，机器停机。

scenes.name: PRIME REGISTERS
lines: Factor the number, and every prime becomes its own register.
把这个数分解质因数，每颗素数就是一根独立的寄存器。
Three quarters is an update: take two from register two, add one to register three.
四分之三是一次更新：从 2 号寄存器取走两份，给 3 号寄存器加上一份。
The divisibility guard says only this: no register may go below zero.
整除守卫说的只是一件事：任何寄存器都不许变成负数。

scenes.name: SIXTEEN STATES
lines: Start at two to the seventeenth and run the four rules.
从 2¹⁷ 出发，运行这四条规则。
Pairs of twos climb to a three, pairs of threes to a five, then seven, then eleven.
两份 2 升成一份 3，两份 3 升成一份 5，再升成 7，再升成 11。
Fifteen transitions, sixteen states, and the machine stops at twenty-two.
十五次跃迁，十六个状态，机器停在 22。
Seventeen is sixteen plus one: sixteen twos became one eleven, one two stayed behind.
17 = 16 + 1：十六份 2 归并成一份 11，剩下一份 2。
Lean checks the whole trace, the first halt at step fifteen, and that a halted machine stays put.
Lean 内核检验了整条轨迹、第十五步首次停机，以及停机后永远不动。

scenes.name: THE ORDER TAX
lines: But one number forgets order: times three, then five, is times five, then three.
可是单个数记不住次序：先乘 3 再乘 5，等于先乘 5 再乘 3。
Scalar programs fake a call stack with extra flag primes, like traffic lights.
标量程序只好额外花掉一批标志素数，像红绿灯一样模拟调用栈。
The chapter's model: make the state an integer quaternion, whose squared length keeps the prime registers.
本章的模型诠释：把状态换成整四元数，它的模方仍保存着素数寄存器。

scenes.name: TWO ORDERS
lines: Take X, one plus two i, and Y, one plus two j, each of squared length five.
取 X = 1 + 2i 与 Y = 1 + 2j，模方都是 5。
X times Y is one, two, two, four. Y times X is one, two, two, minus four.
Both have squared length twenty-five: one number to a scalar, two directions to a spinor.
两者模方都是 25：对标量是同一个数，对旋子却是两个方向。

scenes.name: THE DIVISIBILITY GATE
lines: A gate multiplies on the right by one minus two j, then divides by five.
闸门先右乘 1 − 2j，再把四个分量都除以 5。
X Y gives five, ten, zero, zero. All divide, so the gate opens and returns X.
X·Y 给出 (5, 10, 0, 0)，全部整除，闸门放行，还原出 X。
Y X gives five, minus six, zero, minus eight. Remainders four and two: the gate stays shut.
Gate one minus two i unwinds Y X to Y instead: last in, first out.
闸门 1 − 2i 则把 Y·X 退回 Y：后进先出。
Lean checks the split: equal squared lengths, one clean step for X Y, and none for Y X.
Lean 内核检验这次分离：模方相等，X·Y 干净走一步，Y·X 一步也走不了。

scenes.name: TWO BY TWO
lines: Four integers also make a two by two matrix, with a trace and a determinant.
四个整数也能排成二阶矩阵，带有迹 a + d 与行列式 ad − bc。
Take A as two, three, one, four, and B as one, minus two, five, three.
A B and B A differ, yet both have trace twenty-seven; A B has determinant sixty-five, five times thirteen.
AB 与 BA 不同，迹却都是 27；AB 的行列式是 65 = 5 × 13。
A squared minus six A plus five I is the zero matrix: Cayley-Hamilton, with no eigenvalues.
A² − 6A + 5I 是零矩阵：凯莱—哈密顿，不用特征值。
For every integer matrix, Lean checks: traces cycle, determinants multiply, Cayley-Hamilton holds.
Lean 内核对任意整数矩阵检验：迹可循环，行列式相乘，凯莱—哈密顿成立。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter sixteen.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第十六章
